description: This file defines the MessageMapper interface in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.mapping package, which specifies methods for mapping between ExternalMessage objects and Adaptable objects, including configuration, content type handling, and condition checks.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for this message mapper.

methods.name: getContentTypeBlocklist
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of content types that this mapper should exclude from handling.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Applies configuration settings to the message mapper, potentially throwing exceptions if invalid.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage to a list of Adaptable objects.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps an Adaptable to a list of ExternalMessage objects.

methods.name: getDefaultOptions
methods.description: Returns the default options for this mapper as a JsonObject.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns conditions to check before processing incoming messages.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns conditions to check before processing outgoing messages.

methods.name: findContentType
methods.description: Static method to find the content-type header from an ExternalMessage.

methods.name: findContentType
methods.description: Static method to find the content-type header from an Adaptable.
